overworld: Pick the button that carries out `plan`.
battle: Pick the button that carries out `plan` in this battle. walk_* move the cursor on FIGHT / PKMN / ITEM / RUN or the move list, press_a confirms the highlight, skip_dialog pages battle text.
menu: Move the highlight to the row `plan` names, then press_a. press_b backs out.
naming: Follow `plan` on the letter grid: walks move the cursor, press_a types the letter.
dialog: Page the text unless `plan` says to answer something.
title: Get past the title and intro screens the way `plan` says.
